topic_brief.title: Biochar effects on crop yield across all crops
topic_brief.research_question: Does biochar application increase crop yield across crop types and soil conditions?
topic_brief.population_description: Field and greenhouse crops receiving biochar soil amendment
topic_brief.intervention_description: Biochar application to soil (any feedstock, any rate)
topic_brief.comparator_description: No biochar (unamended control soil, or same fertilization without biochar)
topic_brief.outcome_description: Crop yield or biomass per unit area
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is WITH biochar, Control is WITHOUT biochar
Some studies have biochar + compost vs compost alone - extract as biochar effect
Some studies have multiple biochar rates - extract EACH rate vs control separately
Pot experiments and field experiments both valid but record experiment type
Some studies compare biochar types (feedstocks) - each vs same control
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Treatment = biochar-amended; Control = no-biochar control (SAME base fertilization)
2. Extract EACH biochar rate × crop combination separately
3. If biochar + fertilizer vs fertilizer alone: that's a valid comparison
4. If biochar alone vs nothing: that's also valid
5. Get variance (SE/SD/LSD) and sample size (n/replicates)
6. Record biochar rate (t/ha) and feedstock type
7. Record crop species and soil properties
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +16%; higher in tropical soils (+25%) vs temperate (+10%); sandy soils (+22%) > clay (+10%); field +12%, pot +25%

topic_brief.comparator_description: No biochar (unamended control soil, or same fertilization without biochar)
topic_brief.outcome_description: Crop yield or biomass per unit area
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is WITH biochar, Control is WITHOUT biochar
Some studies have biochar + compost vs compost alone - extract as biochar effect
Some studies have multiple biochar rates - extract EACH rate vs control separately
Pot experiments and field experiments both valid but record experiment type
Some studies compare biochar types (feedstocks) - each vs same control
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Treatment = biochar-amended; Control = no-biochar control (SAME base fertilization)
2. Extract EACH biochar rate × crop combination separately
3. If biochar + fertilizer vs fertilizer alone: that's a valid comparison
4. If biochar alone vs nothing: that's also valid
5. Get variance (SE/SD/LSD) and sample size (n/replicates)
6. Record biochar rate (t/ha) and feedstock type
7. Record crop species and soil properties
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +16%; higher in tropical soils (+25%) vs temperate (+10%); sandy soils (+22%) > clay (+10%); field +12%, pot +25%

row.title: Heterogeneous global crop yield response to biochar: a meta-regression analysis
row.authors: Andrew Crane-Droesch, Samuel Abiven, Simon Jeffery, Margaret S Torn
row.outcome: Overall mean crop yield response to biochar (meta-analytic pooled estimate)
row.treatment_description: Biochar amendment at 3 Mg/ha (standardized rate, first harvest after application)
row.notes: META-ANALYSIS PAPER - NOT A PRIMARY STUDY. This paper synthesizes 365 crop yield response ratios from 40 studies (84 total studies including biomass). Reports ~10% average yield increase at 3 Mg/ha biochar in first year. Individual study data available only in supplementary information (SI). Effect size is pooled across all crops, soils, and biochar types. Response ratio defined as ln(yield_treatment / yield_control). The ~10% is converted from response ratio via RI = (exp(RR)-1)*100%.

topic_brief.title: Biochar effects on crop yield across all crops
topic_brief.research_question: Does biochar application increase crop yield across crop types and soil conditions?
topic_brief.population_description: Field and greenhouse crops receiving biochar soil amendment
topic_brief.intervention_description: Biochar application to soil (any feedstock, any rate)
topic_brief.comparator_description: No biochar (unamended control soil, or same fertilization without biochar)
topic_brief.outcome_description: Crop yield or biomass per unit area
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is WITH biochar, Control is WITHOUT biochar
Some studies have biochar + compost vs compost alone - extract as biochar effect
Some studies have multiple biochar rates - extract EACH rate vs control separately
Pot experiments and field experiments both valid but record experiment type
Some studies compare biochar types (feedstocks) - each vs same control
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Treatment = biochar-amended; Control = no-biochar control (SAME base fertilization)
2. Extract EACH biochar rate × crop combination separately
3. If biochar + fertilizer vs fertilizer alone: that's a valid comparison
4. If biochar alone vs nothing: that's also valid
5. Get variance (SE/SD/LSD) and sample size (n/replicates)
6. Record biochar rate (t/ha) and feedstock type
7. Record crop species and soil properties
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +16%; higher in tropical soils (+25%) vs temperate (+10%); sandy soils (+22%) > clay (+10%); field +12%, pot +25%

topic_brief.title: Biochar effects on crop yield across all crops
topic_brief.research_question: Does biochar application increase crop yield across crop types and soil conditions?
topic_brief.population_description: Field and greenhouse crops receiving biochar soil amendment
topic_brief.intervention_description: Biochar application to soil (any feedstock, any rate)
topic_brief.comparator_description: No biochar (unamended control soil, or same fertilization without biochar)
topic_brief.outcome_description: Crop yield or biomass per unit area
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is WITH biochar, Control is WITHOUT biochar
Some studies have biochar + compost vs compost alone - extract as biochar effect
Some studies have multiple biochar rates - extract EACH rate vs control separately
Pot experiments and field experiments both valid but record experiment type
Some studies compare biochar types (feedstocks) - each vs same control
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Treatment = biochar-amended; Control = no-biochar control (SAME base fertilization)
2. Extract EACH biochar rate × crop combination separately
3. If biochar + fertilizer vs fertilizer alone: that's a valid comparison
4. If biochar alone vs nothing: that's also valid
5. Get variance (SE/SD/LSD) and sample size (n/replicates)
6. Record biochar rate (t/ha) and feedstock type
7. Record crop species and soil properties
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +16%; higher in tropical soils (+25%) vs temperate (+10%); sandy soils (+22%) > clay (+10%); field +12%, pot +25%

topic_brief.title: Biochar effects on crop yield across all crops
topic_brief.research_question: Does biochar application increase crop yield across crop types and soil conditions?
topic_brief.population_description: Field and greenhouse crops receiving biochar soil amendment
topic_brief.intervention_description: Biochar application to soil (any feedstock, any rate)
topic_brief.comparator_description: No biochar (unamended control soil, or same fertilization without biochar)
topic_brief.outcome_description: Crop yield or biomass per unit area
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is WITH biochar, Control is WITHOUT biochar
Some studies have biochar + compost vs compost alone - extract as biochar effect
Some studies have multiple biochar rates - extract EACH rate vs control separately
Pot experiments and field experiments both valid but record experiment type
Some studies compare biochar types (feedstocks) - each vs same control
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Treatment = biochar-amended; Control = no-biochar control (SAME base fertilization)
2. Extract EACH biochar rate × crop combination separately
3. If biochar + fertilizer vs fertilizer alone: that's a valid comparison
4. If biochar alone vs nothing: that's also valid
5. Get variance (SE/SD/LSD) and sample size (n/replicates)
6. Record biochar rate (t/ha) and feedstock type
7. Record crop species and soil properties
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +16%; higher in tropical soils (+25%) vs temperate (+10%); sandy soils (+22%) > clay (+10%); field +12%, pot +25%

topic_brief.population_description: Field and greenhouse crops receiving biochar soil amendment
topic_brief.intervention_description: Biochar application to soil (any feedstock, any rate)
topic_brief.comparator_description: No biochar (unamended control soil, or same fertilization without biochar)
topic_brief.outcome_description: Crop yield or biomass per unit area
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is WITH biochar, Control is WITHOUT biochar
Some studies have biochar + compost vs compost alone - extract as biochar effect
Some studies have multiple biochar rates - extract EACH rate vs control separately
Pot experiments and field experiments both valid but record experiment type
Some studies compare biochar types (feedstocks) - each vs same control
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Treatment = biochar-amended; Control = no-biochar control (SAME base fertilization)
2. Extract EACH biochar rate × crop combination separately
3. If biochar + fertilizer vs fertilizer alone: that's a valid comparison
4. If biochar alone vs nothing: that's also valid
5. Get variance (SE/SD/LSD) and sample size (n/replicates)
6. Record biochar rate (t/ha) and feedstock type
7. Record crop species and soil properties
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +16%; higher in tropical soils (+25%) vs temperate (+10%); sandy soils (+22%) > clay (+10%); field +12%, pot +25%
